    --tbl-bg: #ffffff;
    --tbl-text: #333333;
    --tbl-border: #dfe2e5;
    --tbl-stripe: #f6f8fa;

  body[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body.quarto-dark {
    --tbl-bg: #282c34;
    --tbl-text: #abb2bf;
    --tbl-border: #181a1f;

    --tbl-highlight: #323842;
    --tbl-details-bg: #21252b;
    --tbl-accent: #61afef;
    background-color: var(--tbl-bg);
  }
  
  /* Fix reactable details row background bleed */
  .rt-tr-details {
    background-color: var(--tbl-details-bg) !important;
  }

```{r}
# Render Level 1: Best hit per query
summary_blast_df_ordered$qc_status <- summary_blast_df_ordered$qc_symbol

# Render Level 1: Best hit per query
reactable(
    summary_blast_df_ordered,
    class = "qc-tinted-table",
    rowClass = qc_row_class_fn(summary_blast_df_ordered),
    theme = dynamic_theme,
    highlight = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 50, 
    onClick = "expand",
    style = list(fontSize = "13px"), 
    columns = list(
        query_title = colDef(name = "Query Seq", minWidth = 250),
        hit_acc = colDef(name = "Hit Accession"),
        sciname = colDef(name = "Organism", minWidth = 250),
        qc_status = colDef(
            name = "",
            width = 34,
            minWidth = 34,
            maxWidth = 34,
            align = "center",
            sortable = FALSE,
            cell = render_qc_badge_cell(summary_blast_df_ordered)
        ),
        ident_display = colDef(name = "Identity"),
        cov_display = colDef(name = "Coverage"),
        align_len = colDef(name = "Align Len"),
        evalue = colDef(name = "E-value", cell = function(value) sprintf("%.2e", value)),
        bit_score = colDef(name = "Bit Score", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
        qc_symbol = colDef(show = FALSE),
        qc_sym_class = colDef(show = FALSE),
        qc_row_class = colDef(show = FALSE),
        qc_reason = colDef(show = FALSE)
    ),
    details = function(index) {
        current_query <- summary_blast_df_ordered$query_title[index]
        
        sub_df <- blast_hits %>%
            filter(query_title == current_query) %>%
            arrange(evalue, desc(bit_score)) %>%
            slice_head(n = 10) %>%
            mutate(qc_status = qc_symbol) %>%
            select(
                hit_num, hit_acc, sciname, hit_title, qc_status,
                ident_display, cov_display, 
                # ident_pct, cov_pct, 
                align_len, evalue, gaps, bit_score,
                qc_symbol, qc_sym_class, qc_row_class, qc_reason
            )

        htmltools::div(
            style = "padding: 16px; background-color: transparent; border-left: 4px solid var(--tbl-accent);",
            htmltools::h5(paste("All Hits for Query:", current_query), style="margin-top:0; color: var(--tbl-text);"),
            
            reactable(
                sub_df,
                class = "qc-tinted-table",
                rowClass = qc_row_class_fn(sub_df),
                theme = dynamic_theme,
                highlight = TRUE,
                compact = TRUE,
                style = list(fontSize = "13px"), 
                onClick = "expand",
                columns = list(
                    hit_num = colDef(name = "#", width = 50),
                    hit_acc = colDef(name = "Accession", width = 120),
                    sciname = colDef(name = "Organism", minWidth = 200),
                    hit_title = colDef(name = "Description", minWidth = 300),
                    qc_status = colDef(
                        name = "",
                        width = 34,
                        minWidth = 34,
                        maxWidth = 34,
                        align = "center",
                        sortable = FALSE,
                        cell = render_qc_badge_cell(sub_df)
                    ),
                    ident_display = colDef(name = "Identity", minWidth = 130),
                    cov_display = colDef(name = "Coverage", width = 85),
                    align_len = colDef(name = "Length", width = 75),
                    evalue = colDef(name = "E-value", cell = function(value) sprintf("%.2e", value)),
                    gaps = colDef(name = "Gaps", width = 70),
                    bit_score = colDef(name = "Bit Score", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
                    qc_symbol = colDef(show = FALSE),
                    qc_sym_class = colDef(show = FALSE),
                    qc_row_class = colDef(show = FALSE),
                    qc_reason = colDef(show = FALSE)
                ),
                details = function(sub_index) {
                    hsp_data <- blast_hits %>% 
                        filter(query_title == current_query, hit_acc == sub_df$hit_acc[sub_index]) %>%
                        slice(1)
                
                    # Alignment block utilizing specific One Dark Pro colors
                    htmltools::div(
                        style = "padding: 20px; background-color: #21252b; color: #abb2bf; border: 1px solid #181a1f; border-radius: 6px; margin: 10px 0;",
                        
                        htmltools::div(
                            style = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #56b6c2;",
                            htmltools::div(htmltools::strong("Score: "), paste(round(hsp_data$bit_score, 1), "bits (", hsp_data$score, ")")),
                            htmltools::div(htmltools::strong("Expect: "), sprintf("%.2e", hsp_data$evalue)),
                            htmltools::div(htmltools::strong("Identities: "), hsp_data$ident_display),
                            htmltools::div(htmltools::strong("Gaps: "), paste0(hsp_data$gaps, "/", hsp_data$align_len, " (", round((hsp_data$gaps/hsp_data$align_len)*100), "%)")),
                            htmltools::div(htmltools::strong("Strand: "), paste0(hsp_data$q_strand, "/", hsp_data$h_strand)),
                            htmltools::div(htmltools::strong("Query Cover: "), hsp_data$cov_display)
                        ),
                        
                        htmltools::div(
                            style = "overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre; font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; padding-bottom: 15px;",
                            
                            htmltools::div(
                                htmltools::span("Query  ", style = "color: #c678dd; font-weight: bold;"), 
                                htmltools::span(sprintf("%-6s", hsp_data$q_from), style="color: #5c6370;"), 
                                htmltools::span(hsp_data$qseq, style = "color: #abb2bf;"), 
                                htmltools::span(sprintf(" %s", hsp_data$q_to), style="color: #5c6370;")
                            ),
                            htmltools::div(
                                htmltools::span("       ", style = "color: transparent;"), 
                                htmltools::span(sprintf("%-6s", ""), style="color: transparent;"), 
                                htmltools::span(hsp_data$midline, style = "color: #98c379;") 
                            ),
                            htmltools::div(
                                htmltools::span("Sbjct  ", style = "color: #61afef; font-weight: bold;"), 
                                htmltools::span(sprintf("%-6s", hsp_data$h_from), style="color: #5c6370;"), 
                                htmltools::span(hsp_data$hseq, style = "color: #abb2bf;"), 
                                htmltools::span(sprintf(" %s", hsp_data$h_to), style="color: #5c6370;")
                            )
                        )
                    )
                }
            )
        )
    }
)
```
